artifact_policy: Retain source row indices, domain-separated SHA-256 prompt-context hashes, response token counts, raw/calibrated per-pair margins, probabilities, correctness flags, per-head and aggregate metrics, calibration diagnostics, runtime/resource records, source snapshots, model/data hashes, and a SHA-256 manifest. Never write raw prompt or response text, token IDs, hidden-state vectors, model weights, or transcripts to result bundles. Development may use only test indices [1536,2048); confirmation may use only [2048,2354).
claim_boundary: This outcome-informed replication tests whether fitting a positive scalar on separate calibration pairs lowers pairwise logistic NLL of unchanged linear reward heads on new HH-RLHF prompts from one pinned split and model. It does not establish improved ranking, assistant quality, user utility, safety, policy improvement, RLHF effectiveness, reasoning, task success, generalization, or frontier-scale behavior.

compute_limits.device: CPU only; CUDA, MPS, and accelerator placement are forbidden

dataset.context_parser: For chosen and rejected transcripts, split at the last exact '\n\nAssistant:' marker. The prefix through the marker is the prompt context; the remaining final assistant response must be nonempty. Keep a pair only when the two prompt contexts are byte-identical. Do not normalize case or whitespace.
dataset.license: MIT (as stated by the pinned dataset card)

selection.confirmation_rows: Must not be parsed, tokenized, feature-extracted, or scored until the complete development bundle passes its independent audit. Opaque compressed-container hashing is permitted.
selection.development_rows: May be parsed only by the frozen development runner after protocol, runner, and auditor are committed.
selection.evaluation_selection_rule: For each stage, scan every official test source row in the exact frozen half-open range in ascending order. Apply the same v2 parsing, tokenization, length, and response-token eligibility rules. Exclude all historical and manually piloted contexts, all selected training contexts, and duplicate prompt contexts; for confirmation also exclude every selected development prompt. Retain every remaining eligible unique context in the fixed range. Require at least 128; fail below that minimum and never backfill from another range. The row reader must not return a row at or beyond the range end.
selection.historical_context_inventory_rule: Union of every context hash in the three prior HH result pairs.json files, every source context hash in their training_selection records, and all six manual pilot context hashes recorded in v2; inventory is locked from already-retained artifacts.
selection.training_selection_rule: Tokenize and apply the frozen eligibility rules in this protocol to the pinned train split. Exclude every context hash in historical_context_hashes and manual pilot context hashes; retain the lowest eligible source index per remaining exact context; rank remaining contexts by SHA-256(vare-hh-helpful-context-v1\0 || UTF-8(context)), then context UTF-8 bytes; take the first 768 contexts and form three consecutive 256-pair cohorts. Within each cohort, ranks 0–127 fit the reward head and ranks 128–255 fit its scalar temperature. Fail if 768 fresh contexts are unavailable; do not backfill.

dataset.source_hashing_rule: The runner and auditor may hash the complete compressed test.jsonl.gz container as opaque bytes; this does not decompress or parse JSONL records. For development, the row reader may return records only from [1536,2048). For confirmation, it may return records only from [2048,2354), and only after the complete development bundle passes the independent audit. In both stages, the row reader stops immediately at the exclusive end index and never returns an out-of-range row. Gzip internal buffering is not permission to expose or process a row outside the frozen range.
dataset.test_cache_note: The local v2 record states rows 0–1535 were used by earlier HH studies. This protocol reserves fresh development [1536,2048) and confirmation [2048,2354); no record in either fresh block was opened when this protocol was prepared. The full compressed test container may be hashed opaquely for provenance without exposing or parsing its JSONL records.

feature_extractor.feature: Mean of final-layer causal hidden states over final assistant response tokens only; the full conversation context is included in the causal forward pass. The frozen transformer is not updated.
feature_extractor.token_boundary: Tokenize the exact raw chosen/rejected transcript with the pinned fast tokenizer, add_special_tokens=true, and no chat template; request offset mappings. Mean only non-special tokens whose start offset is at or after the final assistant response start. For selection, both full sequences must be at most 1024 tokens and each response must have at least one feature token; an ineligible row does not reserve its context. Never truncate.

learner.baseline: For each training cohort, fit a one-dimensional Bradley-Terry logistic scorer using chosen-minus-rejected final-response token count. Standardize using that cohort's training pairs only; L2 coefficient 0.1; zero initialization; L-BFGS with the optimizer settings below.

calibration.failed_fit: Abort and retain failure bundle; do not fall back to alpha=1 or alter bounds.
calibration.method: Fit one positive scalar inverse temperature to pairwise margins from 128 training contexts held out from reward-head fitting. Apply that scalar to margins from the identical unchanged reward head; do not refit or alter the head after calibration.
calibration.objective: Mean softplus(-alpha * margin) on calibration-only training contexts; no intercept and no added regularization.

learner.reward_head: A single linear scalar score over standardized frozen response features. Standardization mean and population standard deviation are fit over both responses in that training cohort only; standard deviations below 1e-6 are set to 1. No prompt-only or length feature is appended to the reward head.
learner.trainable_parameters: Reward-head weights only; the Qwen transformer and embeddings are frozen.

metrics.accuracy_and_calibration: The target is that the dataset chosen response is preferred (y=1). Pairwise accuracy is 1 for positive margin, 0 for negative margin, and 0.5 for exact zero. Logistic NLL is softplus(-margin); probabilities are sigmoid(margin). Positive scalar calibration must leave every accuracy exactly unchanged. Accuracy, Brier score, fixed-bin ECE, absolute raw/calibrated NLL, and the length-only baseline are descriptive; the test gate concerns calibrated-minus-raw NLL only.

bootstrap.interval_method: Percentile interval using the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 10000 bootstrap means with NumPy linear quantiles.
bootstrap.resampling_unit: Prompt context. For each context average calibrated-minus-raw NLL equally across the three fixed reward heads, then resample context indices and average. The interval is conditional on these three fitted heads and the selected contexts; it does not estimate head-training or population-sampling uncertainty.

metrics.confirmation_gate: After a passing independent development audit, apply the identical sample floor and NLL gate to the separate confirmation range. A pass supports only lower pairwise HH logistic NLL after positive scalar calibration on this model, data split, and sample; it is not a general reward-model or downstream policy claim.
metrics.development_gate: Pass only if at least 128 unique eligible prompt contexts are retained, mean calibrated-minus-raw NLL is <= -0.10 nats/pair, and the prompt-paired bootstrap 95% interval upper endpoint is < 0. Otherwise do not parse confirmation records.
metrics.primary: Mean calibrated-minus-raw pairwise logistic NLL per prompt, averaged equally across the three fixed heads.
secondary: per-head raw and calibrated pairwise accuracy (which must match exactly)
per-head and mean raw/calibrated logistic NLL
Brier score and 10-bin ECE (descriptive only; unstable at small n)
per-head calibration alpha, objective values, optimizer iterations and gradient norm
wall time, CPU placement, peak RSS, source/model/runtime hashes
metrics.threshold_rationale: The -0.10-nat minimum is a practical-effect design choice informed by the post-hoc v2 estimate (-0.1943 nats); it is outcome-informed and must not be presented as an untouched preregistered threshold. The fresh v3 decision is still frozen before new test-row access.

purpose: Freshly replicate an exploratory v2 calibrated-versus-raw NLL signal while removing the out-of-fold-to-full-head scale-transfer assumption. The v2 confirmation remains non-passing; v3 choices are locked before opening its new test rows.
